_status: PROVISIONAL - NOT APPROVED. PRD BIO-NFR-02 / DEC-04 require benchmarked numbers that the owner approves. These values only make enforcement testable; replace them after a benchmark with realistic bots, maps and hardware, then record the approval in docs/CHANGE_NOTICES.md.
_basis: Chosen as generous multiples of what was measured on 2026-11-24 (Python 3.15.2, Linux x86_64, DefaultSmall, example bot + CPU-load bot + feature-test bot, 1290-1310 rounds): longest turn 19 ms (limit is 52x), longest init 1.4 ms (limit ~1400x), peak RSS 22 MiB (limit 23x), VmPeak 329 MiB (limit 12x), CPU 2.4 s per match (limit 375x). Three small bots are NOT a representative benchmark.
